subject: Code-judge (single-attempt): review task #6 attempt before merge
description: Single-attempt code-review gate for the dup-guard defer-to-judge task (f1653e44.../6), per the dispatcher convention (#3). Blocked_by #6 so it goes ready when #6's worker completes. When dispatched, the worker runs self-learn-judge in SINGLE-ATTEMPT review mode against #6's attempt branch (orch/attempt/f1653e44-5863-4644-bebc-963582c76510-6): review the diff via three-dot git diff main...<branch> and apply the code-review rubric (correctness, scope discipline, dead/redundant code, test presence & quality, style). SPECIAL CORRECTNESS FOCUS for this task: (1) retrieval/recall path actually EXCLUDES pending_dup (retrieval-invisible) notes; (2) the timeout fallback is NON-DESTRUCTIVE — verify it does NOT clear the eager mark / judging anchor / queue membership, and that a timed-out pending_dup note is STILL re-judged later (the forbidden failure mode is dropping it from the queue); (3) only a real verdict stamps judgedAtEpoch + clears provisional; (4) force:true still bypasses. Then APPROVE (hold-merge: record verdict, do NOT merge) or KICK BACK (set_status failed + wired record_decision with required fixes). NEVER force-merge. CAVEAT: get_attempt_diff/merge_attempt not live until daemon restart, so use raw three-dot git diff and hold-merge/record-only mode.
